title: Bake-off (hos): z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
question: Who holds power in NEAR’s House of Stake? Make me a fresh flower, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

conflicts: Locked NEAR balance (own_locked_near) is a separate claim on resources; this flower draws voting power, not locked capital.
Delegation relationships (213 recorded) mean delegates vote with others' veNEAR; the flower shows effective voting power at the block, not raw holdings.
inferred: Named .near accounts are treated as distinct actors; two addresses could still be controlled by one person.
The two largest holders are ranked but unnamed; their influence is measured, their identity is not known.

mappings.why: sqrt scale keeps mid-size delegates visible next to the two ~13-15% leaders
band compressed to max_ratio 2 so the top petals do not crowd out the tail
identity distinguishes named .near accounts (self-declared) from anonymous implicit accounts
solid outline marks self-declared named accounts; none for unknown
largest voting power first, clockwise from the top

power_means.claim: Power in House of Stake is veNEAR voting power: locked NEAR grows into veNEAR over lock time, and accounts may delegate to up to 8 delegates; voting power equals own veNEAR minus outgoing delegations plus incoming.

interpretation.summary: House of Stake governance power is veNEAR voting power: NEAR locked in lockups grows into veNEAR, and holders may delegate to up to 8 delegates. The flower draws the top 60 holders by voting power at block 223167325. Power is concentrated: five accounts hold a majority (Nakamoto coefficient 5), the top two are anonymous hex accounts, and the tail of 405 accounts holds under 0.02%.
unknowns: Per-voter votes on proposals are not read, so how this voting power has actually been exercised is not shown.
Each holder's lockup contract and its staking positions are not included.
Off-chain delegate profiles and real-world identities are not verified; names are self-declared.
Whether any of the top holders share common control is not checked (fusion marks unavailable).

turns.content:
Fresh flower, hot off a live read — no existing published flower existed for this network.

- **Flower**: https://petal.near{{call_00eab716ba334b90a5a5b442.view_url}}
- **What you'll see**: The top 60 House of Stake participants by veNEAR voting power at block 223167325 (2026-11-05). Five accounts form a majority (Nakamoto coefficient 5 of 519): two anonymous hex accounts lead at 15.3% and 12.8% (fig:shares, fig:nakamoto), followed by named delegates spareuni818.near, delegatetoyuen.near and tony_bc.near. The tail of 405 accounts holds <0.02%.
- **Mapping**: height/width = share of voting power (venear-accounts, hos-source); colour = named vs anonymous (account-id); order = largest first, clockwise.
- **Changed from the default**: colour → identity.
- **What this can't tell you**: per-voter votes on proposals, lockup contracts and staking behind each holder, verified real-world identities (names are self-declared), and whether top holders share common control. Addresses are not people.
